issues.summary: The comment starts mid-sentence and needs to be rewritten so it reads properly.

The arch-support check runs on the survivors left after the tie-break, so a stale disowned tree with the same capability (e.g. a plain sm_100 next to the claimed sm_100a) is dropped before the check sees it and is never flagged as fatal.
Add a test covering a disowned tree with the same capability next to a claimed one (sm_100 vs sm_100a), since the existing sm_90a test never exercises that case.
The comment about avoiding includes is inaccurate because core/Tensor.h is included anyway; fix the comment or just include everything.
This comment isn't needed and should be removed.
The comment calls this code generated, but it is written directly in the template, so the comment is misleading.
Use the value directly instead of going through an unnecessary intermediate.
The comment is longer than the function it describes; cut it down.
This comment doesn't seem relevant at this spot and should be removed or moved.
Make the default a lambda that returns "" so the extra conditional checks can go.
